messages:
anya: Plan: enable nova-lite-13b-quant in the model catalog tonight at 23:00 UTC. Change window 23:00-01:00. We're doing a split rollforward — 5% canary -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Fallback ladder: nova-lite-13b-quant -> nova-13b-v1 -> generic-7b-fallback. Pin critical clients to nova-13b-v1 for 72h. Action items: @sam monitor latency, @mike watch errors, @jia run smoke tests. Rollout doc: https://go/redwood/rollouts/nova-lite

sam: ACK — I'll be on pager rotation 22:45-00:30. Will mute noisy alerts unless a threshold is hit.

mike: quick Q — are we enabling quant without new kernel work? any perf caveats I should know?

anya: yes it's INT8 quant. Runtime path tested on our perf harness but kernel fallback may hit CPU in tail cases for long contexts. Expect slight p95 bump for long prompts.

jia: smoke checklist updated in the doc. I'll run against staging ~21:00 and report.

deploy-bot: [4319991120] starting canary enable: target_model=nova-lite-13b-quant canary=5% change_window=23:00-01:00

ops-bot: telemetry rule created: monitor:nova-lite-p95 threshold=300ms duration=10m notify=#eng-oncall

sam: added a temporary rate limit for unauthenticated traffic to reduce cold-start spikes: `route: public-unauthed limit=30r/s`

oliver: Suggest we enable a short KV cache warmup for the canary (first 15m) — otherwise early latency looks worse than steady-state. Recommend cache_warmup=true.

anya: good call @oliver. Setting cache_warmup policy to 15m now.

anya: Pin command for customers who want stability (run from admin):
```
redwoodctl catalog pin --model nova-13b-v1 --duration 72h --reason "pre-rollout stability guarantee"
```

mike: Proposed rollback criteria:
- error-rate >= 0.7% sustained for 5m
- p95 latency >= 350ms for 10m
- regression on 3 eval prompts in a 15m window (quality signal)
If triggered we immediate-roll back to nova-13b-v1 and kickoff quick postmortem.

jia: adding eval harness to auto-compare golden responses; will stream diffs to the rollout doc.

deploy-bot: [4319991136] canary step1 complete (5% traffic). Observability snapshot: p95=190ms (+8% from baseline), errors within baseline.

ops-bot: live metrics: p50=95ms p95=192ms error_rate=0.12% throughput stable.

sam: watching for user-visible error stripes. Will escalate if anything looks off.

anya: if green at +20m we'll bump to 20%. If any rollback signal, immediate rollback and notify #eng-releases and #oncall. :thumbsup:

mike: standing by for rollback ops.

oliver: one-line doc reminder: update model catalog release notes with quant details and prompt best-practices (prefixing, context length guidance).

anya: I'll update release notes after 100% cutover. Thanks team!
